# End-of-Support for ZSOS 24 for Cloud Connector Deployments

**Source:** https://help.zscaler.com/product-usage-terms/end-support-zsos24-cloud-connector-deployments
**Captured:** 2026-09-07 via rendered Zscaler Help article in browser.
**Capture form:** scoped paraphrase of the complete announcement body.

## Announcement — August 30, 2026

The notice identifies Cloud Connector deployments using ZSOS 24 or earlier
on AWS, Microsoft Azure, and GCP as no longer supported. It directs affected
organizations to migrate to ZSOS 42 or higher by **November 30, 2026** to
maintain service continuity. Cloud Connectors already running ZSOS 42 require
no action under this announcement.

## Capture boundary

This notice covers Cloud Connector deployments. It does not describe migration
commands, automatic OS replacement, or the separate Branch Connector notice.
